scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts stryker.config.mjs index.html eslint.config.js dependency-cruiser.config.mjs knip.json scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.node.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts stryker.config.mjs index.html eslint.config.js dependency-cruiser.config.mjs knip.json scripts
scripts.lint: eslint src tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts scripts
scripts.static: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run architecture && npm run deadcode && npm run quality:markers
scripts.test:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run static && npm run test:unit
